Browse dated workshop materials and reports on research, teaching, and community monitoring. These pages preserve historical affiliations and activities; they are not announcements of current registration or ongoing programs.

Selected workshop records include the [2012 data-sharing conclusions](2012-shale-network-workshop.qmd), [2016 presentations and field trip](2016-shale-network-workshop.qmd), [2021 virtual presentations](2021-shale-network-workshop.qmd), and [2022 agenda and abstracts](2022-shale-network-workshop.qmd).
